gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-serif-dives-akuru: Noto Serif Dives Akuru reads with short capitals standing among tall small letters, every curve softly modulated. Goldman's wide, bold display letters make the sharpest foil for it.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-serif-dogra: Goldman's round forms look like open parentheses, spaced wide and set with a big lowercase. Noto Serif Dogra follows with capitals barely taller than its lowercase and a faint thick-thin rhythm.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-serif-ethiopic: Goldman spreads its bold letters wide, with a lowercase that towers over the capitals. Noto Serif Ethiopic gives words that read as solid blocks, and that gap in temperament is what makes the pair work.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-serif-georgian: Goldman's round forms curve like open parentheses, wide and commanding up top. And Noto Serif Georgian answers with lowercase swollen like coiled rope, its contrast subdued from letter to letter.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-serif-gujarati: Goldman sets its bold letters wide, with generous clearance and a lowercase much bigger than its capitals. And Noto Serif Gujarati sits beneath with oversized counters and gently easing joins, so display and text feel like one conversation.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-serif-gurmukhi: Editorial in mood, Noto Serif Gurmukhi has a generous x-height and weight that shifts gradually, like hand-drawn ink. And Goldman above it adds wide, bold, commanding letters that give the page a firm opening line.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-serif-hebrew: Wide, bold, and unmistakably Goldman. Beneath it, Noto Serif Hebrew keeps a tall, sturdy lowercase with subtle thick and thin modulation, so extended text would feel authoritative without ever turning heavy-handed.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-serif-kannada: Wide letters, big round shapes: Goldman announces itself immediately. Noto Serif Kannada does the quieter work, with big counters in a tall lowercase and a moderate thick-thin rhythm across each word.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-serif-khmer: Noto Serif Khmer sets a tall lowercase very close to its capitals, with only modest hairline thinning at the curves, under Goldman's wide display letters. That mix of command and mellow tradition is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-serif-khojki: Goldman brings wide, bold display letters with round forms like open parentheses. But Noto Serif Khojki holds its own, with short ascenders above big bowls and refined, low-key thick-thin variation.
